top_concerns: Only baseline is semantic entropy; no likelihood/logit-based baselines (sequence NLL, max-logit, token entropy, LogTokU, discrete SE), so the gain cannot be attributed to 'energy'
Headline +13% AUROC is vs. a constant score (SE=0) in the single-cluster subset, which is chance by construction

Boltzmann/energy theory is weak (constant Z assumption, logits shift-invariant under softmax, epistemic-uncertainty claim untested) and Eq. 18/19 estimator is ill-specified, with cluster size confounded
Narrow, under-specified evaluation: two datasets, two ~8-21B models, no seeds/CIs, unspecified n, temperature, clusterer, correctness judge
Semantic-clustering ablation lacks control for plain multi-sample averaging; no calibration or selective-prediction analysis despite calibration claims
